title: Complaints.
bodyText: The authority may establish procedures for receiving and processing district-related complaints, conducting research, monitoring matters that arise within the district, and reporting its findings.
bodyHtml: [§206E-197  Complaints.]  The authority may establish procedures for receiving and processing district-related complaints, conducting research, monitoring matters that arise within the district, and reporting its findings. [L 2004, c 188, pt of §2]
